tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: The workspace this API key belongs to (one per key), with its currency and the key's scope.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Home KPIs (spend, paid installs, cost per install vs the previous period), the honest headline, measurement caveats and how many proposals wait for a person.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Campaigns this workspace manages, with state, budget and platform-reported spend and installs in the window.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: One campaign by id (from list_campaigns): numbers, daily spend, pending proposals and what was executed on it.

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.description: The inbox: proposals waiting for a person, ones a guardrail is holding, and the recent execution log (newest first) with each failure's message.

tools.name: create_launch_draft
tools.description: Prepare a new campaign as a proposal in the Loop inbox (needs a propose key). Same checks as the Loop form: connected channel, unique name, budget plan, guardrails. Nothing is sent to the ad platform; a person approves it in Loop.

tools.name: prepare_campaign_change
tools.description: Prepare a change to an existing campaign as a proposal in the Loop inbox (needs a propose key): set a Google Ads search campaign's languages, replace a running search ad's wording and landing page, change a daily budget by more than the per-change limit (the daily cap still applies), give a campaign

tools.name: list_app_events
tools.description: Meta in-app events this workspace's app sends, usable as appEvent in create_launch_draft.

tools.name: list_budget_tests
tools.description: Guardrailed budget tests: campaign, dates, daily range, stop rules and the latest verdict.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_campaign_change" is 940 chars, far longer than this server's median (110). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
